seed.rule: mulberry32 seeded by the 32-bit FNV-1a of "site-engine-1-1-0-rc2-lite:<section>"; the shared 3,000 charts use the section name "charts"

causes.ecliptic-clamp: A row with latitude exactly 0 is out of bounds on S only, its declination's size exceeding the obliquity by at most 1e-12: the package clamps a point on the ecliptic to plus or minus the obliquity.
causes.sun-bound-exemption: A row labelled Sun, out of bounds on S and not on A or P, with latitude of size at most 0.001: convention C3.
causes.bound-boundary: A row's out-of-bounds flag differs and its declination's size is within 1e-12 of the obliquity (on both sides): the package compares its own double, the site its asin value.
causes.orb-boundary: A pair is in one result only, and where it is present its orb is within 1e-12 of its maximum orb: the package decides the inclusive test exactly on the declination doubles, the site on the float difference.
causes.type-tie: A pair's type differs and one of its declinations (on either side) is within 1e-12 of 0: on the equator the two distances are equal.
causes.order-tie: The same pairs in another order, every pair that moves having an orb within 1e-12 of the pair it changes place with (on both sides): an exact sort against a float sort, both stable.
causes.declination-formula: A declination, orb, decA or decB differs by at most 1e-12, every declination involved being at most 60 degrees in size, with (for a pair) the case's pair set, types and order equal: asin of a sine against atan2 of the rotated vector.
causes.separation-exact: separation differs by at most 1e-12: the package reduces the difference exactly modulo 360 and rounds once.
causes.declination-validation: An input S takes and the package refuses with RangeError: a label that is not a trimmed string of 1 to 80 characters without control characters, a body named twice, more than 256 bodies, a number that is not finite or is out of range, an obliquity outside [0, 90].
causes.sect-validation: An input S takes and the package refuses: an altitude that is not finite or is outside [-90, 90], a longitude that is not finite, an unknown convention or key.
causes.sect-convention: Recorded sections only: the two conventions name different sects (convention C1).
causes.composite-validation: A name that is not one of the twelve bodies, or a body twice, or (C2-X) a longitude that is not finite: S takes it, the package throws RangeError.
causes.site-prototype-lookup: A name Object.prototype carries (toString, constructor, valueOf, hasOwnProperty, __proto__): S's hasClassicalDignities answers true and its dignityFor throws TypeError; A answers false and null, and P throws RangeError: a site defect the adoption removes.
causes.dignity-validation: A name outside the twelve bodies, or a sign that is not a lowercase slug: S answers null, [] or false where P throws RangeError.

mapping.declinations: S's aspects are its findDeclinationAspects; A's are the adapter's, in the site's shape; P's are findDeclinationAspects with maximumOrb left out. S's rows are the view's: declinationOf(lon, lat, obliquity) and Math.abs(dec) > obliquity (EclipticView lines 396, 402, 415 and 421); A's are declinationRows(bodies, obliquity).
mapping.sect: S's and A's sectOf({ sunAltitude, sunLon, mercuryLon }); P's sectReading({ convention: "altitude", sunAltitude, sunLon, mercuryLon }) with convention left out and its frozen lists read as lists. S2-E compares P's sectReading({ convention: "ecliptic", ascendant, sunLon, mercuryLon }).sect with the root's sectOf(ascendant, sunLon).
mapping.composite: compositeMidpoints then compositeAspects of its points, field by field in order; C2-P compares buildCompositeTabData's data and compositeDataKey, S's at the base and A's at the head, on the base's pictureBodies.
mapping.dignities: dignityFor, dignitiesFor (as a list) and hasClassicalDignities for each name and sign, as one case; a refusal is compared by its class and message.

S-A.rule: no difference but by orb-boundary, type-tie, order-tie, declination-formula, separation-exact

S-P.description: S against P, recorded with the same causes

referee.description: For every pair P gives in D2-A and D2-T, the type, the inclusion under the maximum orb and the order, from P's own declination doubles in BigInt; a disagreement fails the record.
